fusions.name: Gap Finder
fusions.desc: Threads an arrow at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 36 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Seam Splitter
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Thread the Distance
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 30% further.

fusions.name: Fine Point
fusions.desc: Your piercing damage ignores 15% of the target's armour.
